title: Kai's Rats (Datapack)
description: Datapack + resourcepack that adds in rats... a bit scuffed
body:
# Silly Rat Blorbos In Minecraft!
Requires the [resourcepack!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/kais_rats)

More gallery photos are there too :D

* I tried to use the Modrinth built in package mod feature but the files don't run properly so it's just a datapack + resourcepack combo for now*

**You may need to extract the files and deleted the .DS_Store files, I can't remove them as I am on MacOS**

ALSO ANNIE AKA ANMINTY HELPED A LOT WITH THE CODE!!

Adds in luring rats with Oxbow (food), and functions to make spawning rats, and getting spawn eggs easier!

Rats are a Custom Model Data carved pumpkin—so they are modeled so that when on the head slot, they are on the floor as usual.

Changing the scale of the entity it is on will also change the rat's size.

Rats can be lured from 10 blocks away

Armor stand rats are able to phase through things...

Commands!
*Everything sets a rat to 4 hearts unless I messed coding up*

Gives you a rat
```/function rat:give_rat```
Spawning a rat (on an armor stand)
```/function rat:spawn_rat```
Give you Oxbow
```/function rat:oxbow```
Give you a Rat Spawn Egg
```/function rat:rat_spawn_egg```
Rat Spawn Egg but "sentient" (on a zombie that does 0 attack knockback + damage)
```/function rat:a_rat_spawn_egg```
